errors_detail: First 'docker compose up' with unique COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME failed: 'Bind for 0.0.0.0:5000 failed: port is already allocated' (base docker-compose.yml unconditionally maps host port 5000, colliding with sibling eval containers on the same host)
